Compute the derivatives for SI (MY)

Source: R/adult-MY-SI.R
dMYdt.SI.Rd

Compute the derivatives for the SI module:

$$ \begin{array}{rl} dM/dt = & \Lambda - \Omega \cdot M \\ dP/dt = & f q(M-P) - \Omega \cdot P \\ dY/dt = & f q \kappa (M-Y) - \Omega \cdot Y \end{array} $$

Usage

# S3 method for class 'SI'
dMYdt(t, y, xds_obj, s)

Arguments

t

time

y

dependent variables

xds_obj

an xds model object

s

the vector species index

Value

a numeric vector of derivatives in the module's state-variable order

Note

Derivatives are returned in blocks for M, P, and Y, each in patch order.

State Variables

M

density of adult mosquitoes

P

density of parous adult mosquitoes

Y

density of infected adult mosquitoes

Dynamical Terms

Lambda or \(\Lambda\)

the number of adult mosquitoes emerging, per patch, per day, computed by Emergence

kappa or \(\kappa\)

net infectiousness: the probability a mosquito becomes infected after blood feeding on a human, is computed by Transmission

Parameters

f

blood feeding rates — use setup_f or setup_blood_feeding_rates

q

human fraction — use setup_q or setup_human_fractions

g

mosquito mortality rate — use setup_g or setup_mosquito_mortality

eip or \(\tau\)

extrinsic incubation period — use setup_eip

sigma or \(\sigma\)

emigration rate — use setup_sigma or setup_mosy_emigration

mu or \(\mu\)

emigration loss fraction — use setup_mu or setup_emigration_loss

K

mosquito dispersal matrix — use setup_K_matrix

nu or \(\nu\)

the oviposition rate: the number of egg batches laid in each patch, per mosquito, per day — use setup_nu or setup_egg_batch_rates

eggsPerBatch or \(\Gamma\)

the number of eggs per batch

After basic setup, change_MY_pars can be used for static parameters, or for parameters that are set up as static ports (the default). Use advanced setup to modify dynamic ports.

ODE

Ecology

Adult mosquitoes emerge from aquatic habitats at rate \(\Lambda\) and disperse and die according to \(\Omega\): $$ dM/dt = \Lambda - \Omega \cdot M $$ The model also computes the density of parous adult mosquitoes: those that have blood fed at least once: $$ dP/dt = fq(M-P) - \Omega \cdot P \\ $$

Infection Dynamics

Given the per-capita daily rate of human blood feeding \((fq)\) and net infectiousness \((\kappa)\), the FoI for mosquitoes is \(fq\kappa\). Changes in the density of infected mosquitoes are given by: $$ dY/dt = fq\kappa(M-Y) - \Omega \cdot Y \\ $$

See also

SI, F_fqZ.SI, F_eggs.SI
